prompts.prompt: Create ONE square production game sprite atlas, FOUR equally sized columns by FOUR equally sized rows, exactly 16 full-body dogs in invisible square cells, no captions and no grid lines. Genuine transparent alpha. The reference is an APPROVED CHARACTER DESIGN BOARD; use the specifically named age, not the other ages. Keep its warm caramel brown curly fur, glossy dark eyes, dark nose, floppy ears and polished soft storybook rendering. No accessories, no bows, no collar, no props, no floor, no cast shadows, no UI or text. Make each dog occupy at most 75% of its cell width and height, ample transparent margins, centered horizontally and feet anchored near 85% cell height. Do not cross cell boundaries. Exactly one dog per cell with the same age proportions, identity, fur and scale. Facing viewer in slight three-quarter camera except directional actions. STRICT reading order left to right top to bottom: row1 idle standing, walk right A, sit, sleep curled eyes closed; row2 wake stretching, eat head down no bowl, wag tail right, tilt head inquisitively; row3 hop slightly airborne, sniff nose low forward, chase running right, happy sitting eyes closed smiling; row4 celebrate hind legs front paws up, walk right B opposite legs, wag tail left, rest lying awake. All paws and fur fit inside their own cell. Anatomically coherent four legs except hind-leg celebration. No duplicated extra limbs. Match the approved age's round plump body silhouette, not a slim dog. TARGET AGE: the TOP LEFT dog labeled Cún sơ sinh, WITHOUT bow. Extremely roly-poly baby, nearly a fluffy sphere, oversized round head about HALF total standing height, puffy round belly/cheeks, tiny SHORT stub legs and tiny round paws, small short floppy ears, short curly tail. The legs must NOT become adult-length in walking/running. This dog must look dramatically younger and rounder than the other ages.

prompts.revision: Edit this sixteen-cell ADULT dog sprite atlas while keeping exactly the same 4x4 grid, pose order, caramel color, face identity, genuine transparency and warm painted style. In EVERY cell make the adult's anatomy distinctly more mature: REDUCE HEAD SIZE BY ABOUT 25 percent relative to current body, ENLARGE THE BARREL BODY, CHEST AND BELLY BY ABOUT 30 percent; make the chest broad and legs visibly thick sturdy and taller than juvenile. Lengthen the floppy curly ears slightly and give the muzzle a little more depth. Keep the dog cuddly and very chubby, not lean, not lanky. Do not simply scale the whole dog. Main goal is clearly different HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTIONS: the head should no longer dominate the body like a puppy. Same individual in all sixteen existing poses. Maintain complete dog in each cell, no clipping, transparent gaps between cells, no bow or accessories, no extra limbs, no captions, no shadows, no props. This must read as a fully grown chunky dog rather than another puppy.

prompts.prompt: Create ONE standalone optional head accessory sprite for the approved baby dog from the reference board's BOTTOM RIGHT figure. Only a tiny tuft of caramel-brown curly hair tied with a small pastel BLUE ribbon bow; no dog head or face or ears or body. Faithfully match that tuft and bow: rounded soft curls at the top, petite sky-blue satin bow with two loops, small center knot, two short ribbon ends, gentle painted storybook shading matching the reference. Frontal view, symmetrical enough to overlay on a puppy forehead; delicate cute design, compact. Full tuft and ribbon fully visible, centered with generous clear margins. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, shadow, text, border, frame, labels or other objects. This will be a separate removable overlay layer on a game character; do not include the character.
